module.description: Sass module path as written in @use, e.g. 'igniteui-angular/lib/core/styles/components/checkbox/checkbox-component'

member.description: Name of the member accessed through the import's namespace, e.g. 'component'. Only used when remove is true.

remove.description: Remove the @use statement (and any matching member access) entirely

replaceWith.description: Replace the module path in place, keeping the alias and any member access untouched

changes.description: An array of removed Sass modules whose @use statement (and matching member access) should be dropped
